guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：偏振光學元件製作
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Polarization-optics fabrication
guides.concept: 本課以消光比與延遲量兩個核心指標貫穿偏振元件的製作：先用 Malus 定律與雙折射建立規格的物理意義，再分別處理石英波片的定向、研磨至延遲量與零級複合結構、方解石 Glan 稜鏡的全反射幾何、奈米線柵與 MacNeille 薄膜偏振分光器、Fresnel 菱體的消色差延遲，接著用 Sénarmont 與消光比量測建立誤差預算，最後處理應力雙折射安裝與規格交接。
guides.conceptEn: Two figures of merit, extinction ratio and retardance, run through this course on fabricating polarization optics: Malus's law and birefringence give the specifications physical meaning, then quartz-waveplate orientation, polishing to retardance and compound zero-order construction, the total-internal-reflection geometry of calcite Glan prisms, nanowire-grid and MacNeille thin-film beam splitters and the achromatic retardance of the Fresnel rhomb are treated in turn, followed by Sénarmont and extinction-ratio metrology for the error budget, stress-birefringence-free mounting and specification handoff.
procedure: 線偏振光通過透射軸夾角 θ 的理想偏振片後強度為 I = I₀cos²θ，這是 Malus 定律；真實偏振片以消光比 ER = T_max/T_min 描述，它由材料的二向吸收、晶體的全反射幾何或薄膜的 Brewster 條件決定。元件類別與消光比的典型範圍：拉伸聚合物片與含銀粒子玻璃 10³ 到 10⁴，鋁奈米線柵 10³ 到 10⁴ 且寬頻，薄膜分光立方體 10² 到 10³，方解石 Glan 稜鏡 10⁵ 到 10⁶。消光比規格必須連同波長、入射角與光束發散角一起給，因為這三者都會把漏光放大。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「交叉偏振片與消光比」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

單軸晶體對平行與垂直光軸的偏振有不同折射率，厚度 d 的平板使兩個分量產生相位差 Γ = Δn·d/λ（以波數計），這就是延遲量。石英在 633 nm 的 Δn 約 0.0091，真正的零級四分之一波片只有十幾微米厚，無法獨立研磨，所以有兩種做法：多級波片把延遲量做成 m + 1/4 波（厚度數百微米），或把兩片多級片光軸交叉疊合，使厚度差等於零級厚度，稱為複合零級波片。多級波片的延遲量對波長與溫度的敏感度隨級數線性放大，這是工程選擇的核心。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「石英波片的雙折射與延遲量」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

石英波片的晶片必須切成光軸平行於表面，定向用 X 光繞射或錐光干涉圖確認到 0.1° 以內，再研磨拋光到厚度；因為延遲量對厚度的要求是 0.2 µm 等級，最後一道工序不是量厚度而是邊拋邊量延遲量，直到進入公差。複合零級波片的兩片以光學膠合或空氣間隙組合，膠合會引入應力與雷射功率限制。方解石 Glan–Taylor 稜鏡由兩塊光軸平行於入射面的方解石以空氣間隙組成，切角使尋常光在間隙全反射、非常光穿透；接受角由兩個臨界角夾出，只有幾度，材料的解理與軟度使加工與清潔都比玻璃困難。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「晶體定向、研磨至延遲量與方解石稜鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

鋁奈米線柵以奈米壓印或干涉微影在玻璃上做出週期 100 到 150 nm、占空比約一半的鋁線，當週期遠小於波長時，電場平行線條的偏振被反射、垂直的被透射，寬頻且耐高溫，但週期必須小於波長除以基板折射率才不會產生繞射級。MacNeille 偏振分光立方體靠多層膜內每個界面都在 Brewster 角工作：p 偏振幾乎不反射而 s 偏振被四分之一波堆高反射，條件 n_g² = 2n_H²n_L²/(n_H² + n_L²) 把膜材與立方體玻璃綁在一起。Fresnel 菱體用兩次全反射各產生約 45° 的相位差，延遲量只依賴折射率，幾乎不隨波長變化，是消色差的四分之一波延遲器。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鋁奈米線柵、MacNeille 膜堆與 Fresnel 菱體」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

延遲量以 Sénarmont 法量測：待測片放在 45° 的線偏振光中，其後接一片精確的四分之一波片把橢圓偏振轉回線偏振，旋轉檢偏器到消光，檢偏器轉角的兩倍就是延遲量，量測精度由旋轉台的角度讀數與消光點的判定決定；更高精度與速度用光彈調制器或旋轉補償器的偏振儀。快軸方向以同樣的消光法標定，並刻在元件邊緣。消光比量測的瓶頸不是光學而是動態範圍：10⁶:1 需要偵測器在六個數量級內線性，實務上以鎖相放大、已校正的中性密度濾片分段量測，並把雜散光底限單獨量出扣除。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Sénarmont 補償器與六個數量級的偵測」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

波片的延遲量誤差來自五個獨立來源：製造厚度誤差、工作波長偏離設計、溫度、入射角與安裝應力。入射角的影響與傾斜方向有關：繞慢軸傾斜使延遲量減少，繞快軸傾斜使延遲量增加，量級約為 sin²θ/(2n²) 的相對變化，且隨級數放大。把每一項換算成波數後以均方根相加，與規格比較，就能判斷該用零級、複合零級還是消色差設計，以及公差該往哪一項收緊。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「延遲量誤差預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

任何偏振元件在安裝時受到的機械應力都會透過光彈效應產生附加雙折射，使偏振片的消光比下降、波片的延遲量偏移，而且分佈不均勻。玻璃與熔融石英的應力光學係數約 3 到 4×10⁻¹² /Pa，看似很小，但光程只要幾毫米、應力只要 1 MPa 就能造成數十奈米的延遲。因此元件用三點或撓性無應力座固定，避免彈簧壓片與過緊的螺紋環；膠合界面要選低收縮的光學膠並控制固化，雷射功率高時改用空氣間隙或光學接觸。增透膜必須針對晶體的兩個折射率設計，並把快軸刻記與安裝基準對齊。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「無應力安裝座與膠合界面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

偏振元件的規格表應列出：延遲量與公差（指定波長與溫度）、快軸標記精度、消光比（指定波長、入射角、光束發散）、穿透波前、表面品質、增透膜殘餘反射、損傷門檻、工作溫度範圍與安裝方式限制。系統端把這些數值換算成系統指標，例如 Faraday 隔離器的隔離度由偏振片消光比與 45° 旋轉角誤差共同決定，兩項漏光相加後取分貝。交接資料包含晶體批次與定向紀錄、延遲量與軸向量測報告、消光比曲線與量測條件，讓系統整合者能重現驗收結果。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「偏振元件規格表與隔離度預算」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: Linearly polarized light passing an ideal polarizer whose transmission axis is at angle θ emerges with I = I₀cos²θ, Malus's law; a real polarizer is described by its extinction ratio ER = T_max/T_min, set by dichroic absorption in the material, total-internal-reflection geometry in a crystal or the Brewster condition in a thin-film stack. Typical classes and ranges: stretched polymer sheet and silver-particle glass 10³ to 10⁴, aluminium nanowire grids 10³ to 10⁴ and broadband, thin-film cube splitters 10² to 10³, calcite Glan prisms 10⁵ to 10⁶. An extinction specification must always carry wavelength, incidence angle and beam divergence, because all three enlarge the leakage. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Crossed polarizers and extinction ratio”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A uniaxial crystal has different indices for polarizations parallel and perpendicular to its optic axis, so a plate of thickness d gives the two components a phase difference Γ = Δn·d/λ in waves, the retardance. Quartz has Δn of about 0.0091 at 633 nm, so a true zero-order quarter-wave plate is only tens of micrometres thick and cannot be polished free-standing; either a multi-order plate carries m + 1/4 waves at several hundred micrometres, or two multi-order plates are stacked with crossed axes so their thickness difference equals the zero-order thickness, the compound zero-order plate. A multi-order plate's sensitivity of retardance to wavelength and temperature scales with its order, which is the core of the engineering choice. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Birefringence and retardance of a quartz waveplate”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A quartz waveplate blank is cut with the optic axis parallel to the surface, the orientation verified to within 0.1° by X-ray diffraction or conoscopic interference, then lapped and polished to thickness; because the retardance demands thickness at the 0.2 µm level, the final step measures retardance while polishing rather than thickness, stopping inside tolerance. The two halves of a compound zero-order plate are optically cemented or air-spaced, cementing bringing stress and a laser-power limit. A calcite Glan–Taylor prism is two calcite pieces with optic axes parallel to the entrance face separated by an air gap, cut so the ordinary ray is totally reflected at the gap while the extraordinary ray passes; the acceptance angle lies between two critical angles and is only a few degrees, and calcite's cleavage and softness make machining and cleaning harder than glass. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Crystal orientation, polishing to retardance and calcite prisms”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

An aluminium nanowire grid is made by nanoimprint or interference lithography as 100 to 150 nm pitch lines of about half duty cycle on glass; for pitch far below the wavelength the polarization parallel to the wires is reflected and the perpendicular one transmitted, broadband and heat-tolerant, but the pitch must stay below the wavelength divided by the substrate index to avoid diffracted orders. A MacNeille polarizing cube works with every interface of its multilayer at Brewster's angle: p polarization is barely reflected while s is strongly reflected by the quarter-wave stack, and the condition n_g² = 2n_H²n_L²/(n_H² + n_L²) ties the film materials to the cube glass. A Fresnel rhomb produces about 45° of phase difference at each of two total internal reflections; the retardance depends only on refractive index and hardly on wavelength, giving an achromatic quarter-wave retarder. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Aluminium nanowire grid, MacNeille stack and Fresnel rhomb”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Retardance is measured by the Sénarmont method: the sample sits in linearly polarized light at 45°, an accurate quarter-wave plate behind it converts the elliptical output back to linear, the analyser is rotated to extinction, and twice the analyser angle is the retardance, with accuracy set by the stage's angular readout and the extinction judgement; higher accuracy and speed come from photoelastic-modulator or rotating-compensator polarimeters. The fast-axis direction is marked by the same extinction method and engraved on the edge. The bottleneck in extinction measurement is not optics but dynamic range: 10⁶:1 needs a detector linear over six decades, so in practice lock-in detection and calibrated neutral-density filters are used in stages, with the stray-light floor measured separately and subtracted. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Sénarmont compensator and six-decade detection”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Retardance error in a waveplate comes from five independent sources: manufacturing thickness error, working wavelength away from design, temperature, incidence angle and mounting stress. The angular effect depends on tilt direction: tilting about the slow axis reduces retardance, tilting about the fast axis increases it, with a relative change of order sin²θ/(2n²), amplified by the order. Converting each term to waves and adding root-sum-square against the specification shows whether a zero-order, compound zero-order or achromatic design is needed and which tolerance to tighten. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Retardance error-budget table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Any mechanical stress applied to a polarization element during mounting adds birefringence through the photoelastic effect, lowering a polarizer's extinction and shifting a waveplate's retardance, non-uniformly across the aperture. The stress-optic coefficient of glass and fused silica is only about 3 to 4×10⁻¹² /Pa, yet a path of a few millimetres under 1 MPa produces tens of nanometres of retardance. Elements are therefore held in three-point or flexure stress-free mounts rather than spring retainers or over-tightened threaded rings; cemented interfaces use low-shrinkage optical cement with controlled curing, and air spacing or optical contact replaces cement at high laser power. Antireflection films must be designed for the crystal's two indices, and the fast-axis mark aligned to the mounting datum. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Stress-free mount and cemented interface”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A polarization-component specification should list retardance and tolerance (at stated wavelength and temperature), fast-axis marking accuracy, extinction ratio (at stated wavelength, incidence angle and beam divergence), transmitted wavefront, surface quality, antireflection residual, damage threshold, operating temperature range and mounting limits. The system side converts these into system metrics; for instance a Faraday isolator's isolation is set jointly by polarizer extinction and the error in the 45° rotation angle, the two leakages adding before conversion to decibels. The handoff carries the crystal batch and orientation record, retardance and axis measurement reports and the extinction curve with its conditions, so the integrator can reproduce the acceptance result. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Polarization-component specification sheet and isolation budget”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 用 2° 發散的 LED 光束量 Glan 稜鏡，部分光線超出全反射的接受角而直接漏過，消光比只讀到 10³:1，合格的稜鏡被判為不良；或偵測器在低功率端非線性，漏光被低估十倍。
用品質 λ/50 的四分之一波片當 Sénarmont 補償片，所有待測片的延遲量都帶著同一個系統偏差，整批交貨後在客戶端被判超差；消光比量測未擋雜散光，10⁶:1 的稜鏡只能量到 10⁴:1。
pitfallsEn: Measuring a Glan prism with a 2° divergent LED beam lets rays beyond the total-internal-reflection acceptance angle leak straight through, reading only 10³:1 and rejecting a good prism; a detector non-linear at low power underestimates leakage tenfold.

Using a λ/50 quarter-wave plate as the Sénarmont compensator stamps the same systematic bias on every measured plate and the whole delivery is rejected by the customer; extinction measured without stray-light control reads a 10⁶:1 prism as only 10⁴:1.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 偏振光學元件製作
history.text: 1808 年 Malus 發現反射光的偏振並給出以他為名的定律，1817 年 Fresnel 提出以兩次全反射產生圓偏振的菱體，1828 年 Nicol 以方解石製成第一個實用偏振稜鏡，Glan 與 Thompson 在 1880 年代改良為今天的 Glan 型稜鏡。1929 年 Edwin Land 發明聚合物片偏振片並創立 Polaroid，1946 年 MacNeille 取得薄膜偏振分光器專利；線柵偏振器從 1888 年 Hertz 的無線電實驗、1960 年 Bird 與 Parrish 的紅外線柵，到 2000 年代奈米壓印的可見光鋁線柵，把偏振元件推向大面積量產。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: Malus discovered polarization by reflection in 1808 and gave the law that bears his name; Fresnel proposed the rhomb that produces circular polarization by two total internal reflections in 1817; Nicol made the first practical calcite polarizing prism in 1828, refined by Glan and Thompson in the 1880s into today's Glan-type prisms. Edwin Land invented the polymer sheet polarizer in 1929 and founded Polaroid, and MacNeille patented the thin-film polarizing beam splitter in 1946; wire-grid polarizers run from Hertz's radio experiments of 1888 through Bird and Parrish's infrared grids of 1960 to nanoimprinted visible aluminium grids of the 2000s, bringing polarization optics to large-area mass production. This course reconstructs only public principles and engineering logic.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「Malus 定律、消光比與偏振元件分類」到「規格換算、隔離度預算與交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Malus's law, extinction ratio and polarizer classes" through "Specification conversion, isolation budget and handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
